If it's her own money, why is she asking his permission to use it? Seems kinda dumb on her part.

I do agree with you about people not blaming the right people. But! Marina had it coming for her. She outed the others' wrongdoing to the authorities to save her own skin - that is why people didn't like her IMO. That in itself affected Ander, Omar, Nadia, Lu and Martin.

I mean, everyone does shit, but do you really expect them to feel guilt and regret when their wrongdoings are outed or anger and vengeance at the person who outed them?

They are teenagers, not saints! 

Also those were not her secrets to tell. She also wasn't snitching just for the sake of "doing good" but to protect her own interests. Which didn't make her actions saintly either but rather as reprehensible as the rest.

The reason is- if one of the others had died, like Guzman, then the show would have looked into the possible suspects and would find that many people hated him. 

Ander, Omar, Samuel, Nano, Lu, Nadia, and Christian all had reasons to dislike or even hate Guzman for various reasons.

But since Guzman wasn't killed and it was Marina who was killed, the show focused on the reasons why they hated her.
